title: Attribute names in fenced code and legacy `{@...}` attributes can break out of the tag and inject HTML
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. With `attr_list` on a heading, an attribute name containing characters that are not valid in an XML name is cleaned up: `# Title { x># Some python code\n` Actual: `
` 2. `markdown.markdown('text {@x>

` Attribute names should be cleaned the same way everywhere (each run of invalid characters becomes `_`); valid names must be unchanged.
acceptance: Both reported inputs render exactly as expected, with no markup injected through an attribute name
Valid attribute names on fenced code blocks and with legacy_attrs are unchanged
Regression tests are added for both cases
